name: The Blessed Sacrament, or the Works and Ways of God
name_pt: O Santíssimo Sacramento, ou as Obras e os Caminhos de Deus
author: Fr. Frederick William Faber
desc: Faber's treatise of 1855 on the Eucharist as the summit of God's works: a prologue on the triumph of the Blessed Sacrament, four books (the Blessed Sacrament the greatest work of God, the devotion of Catholics, a picture of God, a picture of Jesus) and an epilogue on reparation.
desc_pt: O tratado de Faber (1855) sobre a Eucaristia como o cume das obras de Deus: um prólogo sobre o triunfo do Santíssimo Sacramento, quatro livros (o Santíssimo Sacramento, a maior obra de Deus; a devoção dos católicos; um retrato de Deus; um retrato de Jesus) e um epílogo sobre a reparação.
editor: Fr. Frederick William Faber (American edition, Baltimore: Murphy, 1855)
edition: The Blessed Sacrament, or the Works and Ways of God (American edition, 1855), University of Toronto scan, Internet Archive full-text OCR.
srcnote: The preface, the prologue and the epilogue are kept; the publisher's note, the analytic table of contents and the index are dropped.
